sentence: This project builds a tool that makes detailed molecular maps of biological tissues, showing each cell.
This project builds a tool that uses natural language processing and machine learning to help clinicians identify Gulf War Illness in the electronic medical record.
This project studies how protein specific appetite is controlled and how blue light and social isolation change food choice.
This project builds imaging methods using magnetic resonance fingerprinting to tell early whether chemotherapy is working on breast cancer.
This project studies how genetic variation changes gene regulatory networks as human cells develop.
This project studies epigenetics in reproduction, with the aim of treating human infertility.
This project builds mathematical models of how complex traits evolve to learn about the forces shaping genetic variation.
This project studies how immune checkpoint inhibitors raise circulating phenylalanine and how that lets neutrophils suppress T cells.
This project tries to suppress the active reservoir of HIV in T cells and microglia by delivering drugs precisely to the HIV promoter.
This project uses microscopy to watch leukocytes in real time and track how cells migrate.
This project builds an ultrasound tool that images neural circuits in the spinal cord using blood flow as a sign of nerve activation.
This project builds drug carriers that help gene therapies cross the blood-brain barrier to treat disorders of the central nervous system.
This project studies how viruses use the machinery of host cells to make the proteins they need to replicate.
This project tries to overcome the cytotoxic T cell response so CRISPR gene editing lasts longer in canines with Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
This project builds gene set methods that estimate cell type and phenotype for individual cells instead of groups of cells.
This project studies how empathy circuits change with healthy aging and frontotemporal dementia, and tests oxytocin signaling as a treatment for loss of empathy.
This project studies how a stem cell that forms the vertebrae drives breast cancer metastases to the spine.
This project collects and studies donated brain tissue to measure the changes of Alzheimer's disease and related dementias using imaging and deep learning.
This project studies how the nucleus accumbens and its inputs drive craving for oxycodone in rats after prolonged abstinence.
This project studies mutations in single sperm to find out what they look like, what they do, and how they build up with age.
